definitions.explanation: A group of people united by shared political beliefs or interests, or a faction within a larger political organization. Can refer to formal political parties or informal factions.

examples.japanese: {党派|とうは}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Cooperation beyond party lines is necessary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{党派|とうは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Representatives from various political factions gathered.

examples.japanese: {党派|とうは}⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}まなかった→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Partisan conflict intensified and the discussion made no progress.

notes:
Composed of {党|とう} (party) + ⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ (faction, school). Refers broadly to political groups, factions, or partisan divisions. Common in political news and commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {党派|とうは}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to transcend party lines
- {党派|とうは}⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧: partisan conflict
- {党派|とうは}⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧: party/factional politics
- {党派|とうは}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: partisan coloring, party affiliation
- {超|ちょう}{党派|とうは}: bipartisan, cross-party

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{派閥|はばつ}→派閥：16960_habatsu⟧: faction (within a party) — specifically an internal power group, often with negative connotations of backroom dealing
- ⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧: political party — a formal, established party rather than a general faction
- {会派|かいは}: parliamentary group — factions within a legislature that may cross party lines
